blocks.text: DAVAO CITY—Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday branded dismissed policeman Rudolfo Gracioso as someone “paid” to destroy her reputation. During a press conference here, Duterte said Gracioso was only out to settle a score with former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, supposedly over money, and it was unfortunate that she was dragged into it. Duterte denied Gracioso’s allegations, especially about receiving money stuffed in suitcases.
